description:
FILED s401 (Fable review probes, docs/fable-answers-s400.md Â§9).

PROBED vs perl 5.40.3 (scratchpad incprobe5.pl):

    push @INC, $dir;  require MyLocal;  print MyLocal::hi();
        perl: hi from MyLocal
        PCL : Can't locate MyLocal.pm in @INC (@INC contains: ...no $dir...)
    BEGIN { push @INC, $dir }  require MyLocal;        both: works
    (nested: inside a block/sub the require already stays INLINE â s149, and
     the v2 _fallback_stmt_capture fix â only the FILE-TOP case hoists)

EMISSION (./pl2cl):
    (p-eval-always
      (p-require "MyLocal"))            <- declarations bucket
    (p-run-compile-phase-blocks)
    (p-push @INC "...")                 <- runs AFTER the require

perl's `require` is a RUNTIME statement; only `use` is compile-time.  The
hoist predates the emitted `(pcl:p-defpackage :MyLocal)` line, which is what
guarantees read-time package existence today â so the hoist may have no
remaining purpose.

POPULATION (static, rough, s401): 11 files across perl-tests + perl's t/
write @INC at column 0 outside BEGIN; ONE also has a column-0 bareword
require after it: t/io/perlio.t.  User scripts (`unshift @INC,
"$FindBin::Bin/../lib"; require Foo;` at file top) are the real population.
Loud, not silent â a filler.

FIX = A MEASUREMENT, not a patch: emit the file-top `require Bareword` at its
own position (plain runtime `(p-require ...)`, exactly what the nested case
emits), then tools/corpus-diff.pl over BOTH populations (tools/emission-ab.pl
for the companion + lib) and explain every diff.  If something depends on
the hoist (a sub of the required module called from a BEGIN block? a
prototype consumer?), record it HERE and keep the hoist for that shape only.
Also check the `require "file.pl"` and `require $var` spellings take the same
path.  #321 (coderef @INC hooks) touches the same p-require path â note it.

BAR: corpus-diff explained per file; gate; sweep if any diff (a `require`
ordering change is runtime-visible); the probe above identical to perl; a
Pl/t row (push then require).


DONE s404 (commit 987c78a) — measurement AND flip.  The other two spellings
(`require "f.pl"`, `require $var`) already emitted in place; only the
bareword form hoisted.  emission-ab --env over both populations: 52 DIFF /
605 SAME / 0 RCDIFF (7 perl-tests, 1 lib shim, 44 in perl's t/), every diff
exactly the p-eval-always form moving to its own position.  Nothing depended
on the hoist.  Gen v2-148 -> v2-149, artifacts regenerated.  parser2-01.t's
"v1 parity" expectation rewritten under the four-conjunct rule + a runtime
guard row in use-require-01.t.  Sweep GATE clean, TOTAL 18516; gate 145/5299.
